answered.verdict: premise REFUTED for one major indexer - Agent402 sends body:"{}" (non-empty HTTP body) on every POST probe, both live-quote and paywall health probes; its source explicitly treats any non-402 as 'route is not paywalled' -> ok:false -> rolling-health drop. A naive SwarmX empty-body free-tier gate would therefore serve Agent402 a free 200 and get us routed around during the exact discovery window we need. Safe indexers: x402scan (empty-body probes per issue #781 + DISCOVERY.md), TOLL*402 (never invokes POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), aeX402 (GET-only). CDP Bazaar is settle-coupled (low risk). UNRESOLVED: 402 Index exposes a probeBody register field implying body-sending POST health checks by default (RQ-033). UA/IP exemptions are unreliable - Agent402 sends no identifiable UA.
answered.directive_proposed: Amend DIR-008 free-tier work order BEFORE implementation: replace the non-empty-body trigger with required-field validation gating - free tier fires only when parsed JSON contains all required SKU inputs; {} or missing-field bodies fall through to the existing 402 challenge regardless of payment header (also satisfies x402scan's own 'probes reach 402 before body validation' spec). Add regression test: POST /v1/sentiment with body {} must return 402, never 200.

answered.verdict: feasible, premise corrected - SwarmX's 3/day free tier is NOT wallet-keyed: read from shipped source (src/server/x402Gate.ts), quota is checked PRE-payment at the gate (only when no payment header AND non-empty request body), keyed by client IP + cookie with effective count = MAX(cookie, ip), in-memory with 24h entry expiry. Wallet-keying pre-payment is structurally impossible (payer address only exists after settlement). Paid requests bypass the free branch entirely so verify_payment is untouched; empty-body discovery probes always get the 402 challenge and never burn quota. Abuse surface is IP rotation (not wallet rotation); bound is marginal compute plus optional server-wide daily cap.
answered.directive_proposed: Amend DIR-008 free-tier work order: implement SwarmX's exact pattern in revenue_server.py + sui_market_server.py (IP-keyed dict, 3/day on /v1/sentiment, gate only on no-payment-header + non-empty body, X-Free-Remaining header, 200-calls/day server-wide cap). Do NOT build wallet-keyed quota.
